set.prevailing_wage_basis: HOME: 24 CFR 92.354(a) requires Davis-Bacon wages on construction contracts for housing with 12 or more HOME-assisted units (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/24/92.354). CDBG-assisted residential construction triggers Davis-Bacon at 8 or more units. Below those thresholds, federal wage rules do not apply and state prevailing wage depends on Labor Code 1720 project facts.

set.prevailing_wage_basis: HUD CoC: 24 CFR 578.99(h) states the Davis-Bacon Act does not apply to the CoC program (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/24/578.99). HHAP guidance does not state a prevailing wage rule; state prevailing wage would apply to an HHAP- or CoC-funded construction or rehab project only under Labor Code 1720 depending on project facts and 1720(c) exemptions. Most local HHAP spending here is services, outreach and interim housing operations.
